selection_data: event-grouped nested cross-validation on released competition training data

target_finger_movement_state_head.description: The same residual LSTM state predicts trajectory and a balanced target-finger movement/rest logit. The direct LARS path remains fixed.

movement_state_plus_correlation_objectiv.decision: The combined objective crosses +0.1 PCC only on the S2-middle screening pair. With its weights frozen in advance, it is worse than the state-only objective on S1-index and S3-thumb, so it is not a common-model improvement.

movement_weighted_trajectory_ablation.excluded_preliminary_runs: Concurrent 2x and 4x screens accidentally used the script defaults of hidden size 10 and a different checkpoint grid. They are excluded from model comparison.
movement_weighted_trajectory_ablation.decision: Reject: emphasizing movement-bin squared error does not address the S1-index tuning gap and remains well below the requested +0.1 PCC gain.

auxiliary_velocity_head_ablation.description: A training-only velocity regressor reads the same LSTM state as the trajectory and movement outputs; it adds no temporal or spatial feature branch.
auxiliary_velocity_head_ablation.decision: Reject: auxiliary velocity regression worsens trajectory PCC, event NMSE, rest-state error, amplitude slope, and trajectory velocity PCC relative to the matched state-head control.

S1_index_head_learning_rate_screen.decision: Use 3e-4 for further S1-index candidate-residual diagnostics. It improves every monitored trajectory diagnostic over the matched 1e-4 control, but its +0.027 PCC gain remains far below +0.1.

S1_index_two_stage_stem_tuning.decision: Reject: two-stage end-to-end tuning is 0.0049 PCC below the matched frozen-stem 3e-4 run and does not close the requested gain.

S1_index_recurrent_capacity_screen.decision: Use 64 units for any further S1-index diagnostics. Capacity improves phase-sensitive velocity correlation and rest suppression, but PCC plateaus near 0.757 and remains far below +0.1 over initialization.

S1_index_state_conditioned_gain.description: A scalar, smoothly bounded multiplicative gain is driven by the existing LSTM movement logit. It is initialized to exactly one and adds no feature branch.
S1_index_state_conditioned_gain.decision: Reject: weak modulation is neutral and stronger modulation worsens PCC, event NMSE, movement RMSE, and amplitude slope.

S1_index_trace_diagnostics.visual_finding: The late high-amplitude event is detected with largely correct flexion timing, but peak amplitudes remain compressed and isolated resting transients remain. Global lag zero is optimal, so a fixed alignment correction is not indicated.

S1_index_softplus_gradient_audit.description: The derivative of the beta-10 Softplus was measured at each split-local LARS preactivation before residual tuning. Movement means and lower deciles are reported across the three outer refits.
S1_index_softplus_gradient_audit.decision: Softplus saturation is not the learning bottleneck. LARS underestimates movement amplitude, but the residual path receives a strong local gradient on essentially every movement bin.

S1_index_frozen_feature_residual_predict.description: Diagnostic regressors are trained independently inside each outer-training scope. Ridge alpha is chosen with interval-grouped inner folds. A fixed histogram-gradient-boosting probe sees the LARS trajectory, current candidate atoms, and four causal exponential summaries. It is not a candidate production decoder.
S1_index_frozen_feature_residual_predict.decision: The residual is genuinely nonlinear: the nonlinear temporal-summary probe improves every outer fold, whereas both ridge probes are weak or harmful. However, it is only 0.0027 raw PCC above the best LSTM and still gains only 0.062 over LARS. This is evidence against a large unexploited optimization reserve in the frozen feature bank, not a formal upper bound.

S1_index_signed_leaf_pooling.description: Each existing wavelet leaf retains one scalar statistic: initialized log-energy plus a zero-gated signed within-bin mean. Spatial filters and wavelet taps are frozen, so this isolates phase-sensitive pooling without adding a filter branch.
S1_index_signed_leaf_pooling.decision: Do not promote: signed pooling adds only 0.0017 PCC over the energy-only 64-unit model, worsens most morphology diagnostics, costs about 13--14 minutes, and learns inconsistent leaf signs across outer folds.

S1_index_recurrent_input_geometry.description: The immutable split-local LARS path keeps its full 25-bin lag bank. Only the input presented to the nonlinear residual LSTM changes; every variant remains one spatial layer, one wavelet tree, and one recurrent decoder.

four_recent_bins.decision: Reject: explicitly restoring four lag bins reintroduces redundant inputs and loses most of the current-bin gain.

fixed_width_compile_control.decision: Keep for efficient screening: zero padding changes no signal and avoids recompiling a different graph for every split-local feature width.

fixed_width_low_learning_rate.decision: Reject: a lower rate with a longer schedule does not improve on 3e-4.

fixed_width_plus_direct_lars_context.description: The same residual LSTM receives the fixed LARS preactivation as one additional scalar; this is contextual input, not a second feature branch.

current_bin_plus_correlation_objectives.decision: Reject: the correlation objectives that helped S2-middle still reduce S1-index PCC by 0.0135 and worsen rest error, movement RMSE, amplitude slope, and velocity PCC after the recurrent input is narrowed.

current_bin_plus_interlevel_normalizatio.description: Every intermediate wavelet-tree output gains a zero-initialized interpolation toward its normalized value. The paths can change only during the low-rate end-to-end stage and do not add a feature branch.
current_bin_plus_interlevel_normalizatio.decision: Reject: all three outer-training scopes select the unchanged frozen checkpoint, and even the best normalized continuation is worse than the best frozen checkpoint on every inner-fold aggregate.

current_bin_plus_interlevel_skip.description: Every wavelet split gains a zero-initialized bypass from its parent representation. The bypass gates can change only during the low-rate end-to-end stage and remain inside the single tree.
current_bin_plus_interlevel_skip.decision: Reject: all three scopes again select the unchanged frozen checkpoint, and the best skip-tuned continuation is worse on every inner-fold aggregate.

current_bin_minibatch_screen.description: Checkpoint grids are scaled inversely with batch size so each candidate sees approximately the same number of 100-bin sequences as the batch-24 reference.
current_bin_minibatch_screen.decision: Use batch 48 for any continuation of this S1-index residual family. Smaller batches are much worse; batch 96 is statistically indistinguishable but slightly lower; batch 192 collapses. The new best is 0.785 PCC (+0.059), so batch regularization does not close the requested +0.1 gain.

all_candidate_causal_closure.description: The LSTM receives the current-time source stream for every atom represented anywhere in the screened candidate lag bank, while the direct LARS path remains unchanged.
all_candidate_causal_closure.decision: Reject: causal closure suppresses resting error but dilutes the useful recurrent state with many streams and is 0.0167 PCC below the narrower current-bin-plus-direct model.

nonzero_lars_stream_causal_closure.description: The LSTM receives current-time values only for spectral streams represented by nonzero split-local LARS coefficients. The direct LARS prediction still uses the complete selected lag bank.
nonzero_lars_stream_causal_closure.decision: Reject: restricting causal closure to nonzero-LARS streams recovers some performance but remains 0.0062 PCC below the zero-lag-screened current-bin-plus-direct model and has worse event NMSE, movement RMSE, amplitude slope, and velocity PCC.

S1_index_recurrent_input_geometry.decision: Use current-bin recurrent inputs plus the fixed direct LARS context for the next single-branch diagnostic. It is the strongest S1-index residual model so far at 0.782 PCC, but its +0.056 gain remains below +0.1.

excluded_invalid_ablation: A cached-feature-only run cannot exercise interlevel wavelet paths and is excluded. The runner now rejects that configuration.

near_zero_residual_output_ablation.decision: Reject: worse for S1 and S2 and only 0.0016 PCC above the exact-zero control for S3.

fixed_width_candidate_direct_path.description: The frozen split-local LARS function is algebraically expanded into the 712-wide standardized candidate basis, with zeros for unselected candidates. This removes fold-dependent decoder widths without changing predictions.

concurrent_initialization_cache.implementation: An OS-level split lock now serializes cache creation and readers recheck the completion marker after acquiring it.
concurrent_initialization_cache.decision: Keep: the matched control and two auxiliary-velocity runs loaded identical split-local initializations while training concurrently.

S3_thumb_current_bin_batch48_generalizat.description: The S1-selected current-bin recurrent geometry and batch-48 schedule are transferred unchanged to S3 thumb. The spatial/wavelet stem and direct split-local LARS path remain frozen; only the 64-unit residual LSTM and its trajectory/movement heads train.
S3_thumb_current_bin_batch48_generalizat.data_scope: event-grouped nested cross-validation on released competition training data
S3_thumb_current_bin_batch48_generalizat.visual_finding: The LSTM more reliably detects movement state, suppresses most resting offset, and raises the flexion envelope. It still smooths across within-event extension valleys, compresses peak amplitude, and retains one conspicuous resting false-positive episode.
S3_thumb_current_bin_batch48_generalizat.decision: The transferred recipe meets the requested numerical threshold at +0.1034 PCC and improves every stitched morphology summary reported above. Count it as a numerical pass, but not as a solved trajectory: fine movement dynamics remain underfit.

all_pair_gain_screen.description: The S1-selected current-bin, batch-48 residual-LSTM recipe was frozen before transfer to the twelve previously unscreened subject-finger pairs. Each pair refits its own split-local target baseline, CSP, and LARS; only full-rank split-local FastICA rows are reused. S2-middle retains its separately inner-selected correlation/velocity objective, and S3-thumb is the earlier unchanged transfer run.
all_pair_gain_screen.data_scope: event-grouped nested cross-validation on released competition training data

S2_middle.finger_specific_change: movement-state plus within-sequence level and velocity correlation objective

all_pair_gain_screen.fixed_transfer_summary: None of the twelve newly screened pairs reaches +0.1. S1-thumb is the strongest new positive gain at +0.046; S2-little and S3-ring are small positives; seven transfers reduce PCC. The full diagnostic table is generated at outputs/candidate_residual_current_bin_batch48_oof_all_v1/screen_summary.json.
all_pair_gain_screen.morphology_pattern: Several PCC failures still reduce resting RMS and raise amplitude slope or movement-state accuracy. The recurrent head is learning a smoother movement envelope, but often loses within-event timing or movement amplitude sufficiently to reduce raw PCC.
all_pair_gain_screen.decision: Reject the batch-48 current-bin recipe as a universal decoder. Preserve S2-middle and S3-thumb as numerical passes, retain S1-index as the best sub-threshold residual result, and use finger-specific spectral-spatial initialization or objectives for the remaining pairs.

S2_little_interlevel_normalization_lr_se.description: The near-threshold hidden-level normalization result was bracketed with interlevel-path learning rates of 3e-4 and 3e-3. Each learning rate selected its optimizer-update schedule using only inner folds. A second nested decision selected among learning rates from the chosen schedule's inner mean raw PCC before untouched outer predictions were stitched.
S2_little_interlevel_normalization_lr_se.decision: Do not count S2-little as a pass. The fixed 1e-3 diagnostic misses +0.1 by 0.000041, and the leakage-safe inner-selected learning-rate route gains only +0.0819. Further generic interlevel-rate tuning is not justified.

visual_diagnostic: The residual LSTM consistently improves movement-state detection and event amplitude over its split-local LARS initialization. The new S3-thumb OOF trace also shows the remaining limitation clearly: it tracks the event envelope better than individual flexion-extension cycles and retains an isolated resting false-positive episode.
decision: Keep the auxiliary state head, efficient fixed-width recurrent inputs, and concurrency-safe initialization cache experimental. The complete 15-pair screen has only two numerical passes: S2-middle reaches +0.103 with its cross-fold-selected correlation/velocity objective, and S3-thumb reaches +0.1034 with the current-bin, batch-48 recipe. S1-index remains the best sub-threshold result at +0.059. None of the twelve fixed-recipe transfers reaches +0.1, and seven reduce raw PCC despite often improving rest suppression or movement-state accuracy. S2-little reaches +0.09996 under the fixed 1e-3 interlevel-path rate, but the inner-selected learning-rate route gains only +0.0819, so it is not promoted. Movement-weighted trajectory MSE and explicit auxiliary velocity regression both fail on S1-index. Four explicit lag bins, causal closure, two-stage stem tuning, and state-conditioned output gain are worse, while signed leaf pooling adds only 0.0017 PCC with unstable fold-wise signs. Reject near-zero residual initialization. On the current-best S1 geometry, zero-gated interlevel normalization and skip connections are both rejected because every inner selection retains the unchanged frozen checkpoint. Softplus gradients are healthy, and a nonlinear frozen-feature probe is only 0.0027 PCC above the best S1 LSTM. The next improvement attempt must change finger-specific spectral-spatial evidence or the target objective rather than repeat generic optimizer, batch-size, or wavelet-path sweeps.
